description: This file is a class definition for SandboxNodeVisitor, which implements the NodeVisitorInterface of Twig. It manages node traversal for security and code analysis purposes within Twig templates, specifically handling nodes like ModuleNode, PrintNode, SetNode, and various expression nodes. It encapsulates logic for security checks and node wrapping to enforce sandbox constraints.

classes.name: SandboxNodeVisitor
classes.description: A final class implementing NodeVisitorInterface for traversing and modifying Twig nodes, with a focus on sandbox security.

methods.name: enterNode
methods.description: Handles logic when entering a node during the traversal, such as identifying module nodes, tags, filters, functions, and wrapping nodes for security.

methods.name: leaveNode
methods.description: Handles logic when leaving a node during traversal, such as final security checks and resetting state flags.

methods.name: wrapNode
methods.description: Wraps specific expression nodes with security-related nodes for sandboxing.

methods.name: wrapArrayNode
methods.description: Recursively wraps array elements within nodes for security.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of this node visitor, which is 0.
